indexes._comment: The drainer queries state == pending ordered by nextAttemptAt. A composite of an equality and a different order-by field needs an index, and the emulator does NOT enforce that — so this query passes every test here and fails on the first real deploy. Deploy it with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
tidyOutbox: pending rows older than two weeks, oldest first. Equality on state plus a range on createdAt needs a composite index; the emulator does not enforce it.
The inbox: unseen bookings, oldest first.

createLink's clash check: live links (revoked == false) not yet expired (expiresAt > now). An equality plus a range on a different field needs a composite index; the emulator does not enforce it, so without this the check passes every test and fails the first time she makes a link on the real service.
